homeProblemGrid.headline: What building problem are you facing?
homeProblemGrid.subhead: Most homeowners search for symptoms, not solutions. Start here — we'll help you understand what's wrong before you spend money fixing it.

doctorPositioning.headline: We diagnose before we prescribe
doctorPositioning.subhead: Contractors sell solutions. We find the root cause first — like a doctor for your building.

points.title: Inspection first
points.body: Every project starts with a site visit and diagnosis — not an instant quote over WhatsApp.

points.title: Evidence-based repair
points.body: NDT, moisture mapping, and crack mapping before we recommend PU injection, waterproofing, or retrofitting.

points.title: Long-term fix
points.body: We fix the cause, not the symptom. No paint-over-leak patches that fail next monsoon.

hero.headline: Your building has a problem. We find out why.
hero.subheadline: Water leaking? Cracks spreading? Damp walls every monsoon? Don't guess — get a proper diagnosis from Guwahati's building rehabilitation specialists.

inspectionCta.headline: Not sure what's causing the problem?
inspectionCta.body: Upload photos or book a site visit. We'll inspect, diagnose, and give you a clear repair plan — before you commit to any work.
